title: Seldon triage proposal
description: ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/seldon/proposals/<id>.json: an agent's proposal for open drift items, stored by the engine (`seldon drift propose`), pointed to by index.triage, applied by `seldon drift apply` (ADR-0034 §6, ADR-0035 §6). Nothing in it is written to the logbook until it is applied. Every text is user content: shown escaped, never evaluated.

logbook.description: the logbook it was made for (canonical path); the index lists only this logbook's proposals

applied.description: null until `seldon drift apply` applied it

eventId.description: the drift item's event id (a group's leader)

caseId.description: link only: the case the change belongs to

title.description: explain only: the title of the completed case `drift explain` makes

intent.description: explain only: why the change was made

crisis.description: the item was a crisis when proposed (ADR-0028); `drift apply` applies it only when named by --item

ref.description: journal: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM; event: a ledger id; snapshot: its number; case and plan: a case id

text.description: what the engine resolved the ref to (a journal line, an event's summary, a snapshot's description, a case title, a Plan line)
